response.sql: WITH pr AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.boxx * 1.0 / s.boxz) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), x AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS excess FROM pr) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, excess FROM x ORDER BY (excess IS NULL), excess DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A spatial record with boxz = 0 has a missing (NULL) ratio, since SQLite returns NULL for division by zero. Such records are ignored in the project average, and projects with no valid ratio get NULL excess and sort last.
The top 10 are chosen purely by excess, descending, without filtering to excess > 0. Projects with a NULL funding source are treated as one group.
